turns.question: How many site sessions were there per order placed between 20 September and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no sessions-per-order metric, so I did not compute a ratio; the closest metrics gave 7 Site sessions and 75 Orders (cancelled included) for 20 September to 2 October 2026.
